status_meanings.certified: Covered by engine tests and at least one runtime or browser path where applicable.
status_meanings.partial: Core behavior exists, but important variants or UI paths are not fully covered.
status_meanings.gap: Known missing behavior or insufficiently implemented.
status_meanings.blocked: Needs a new engine subsystem or upstream data before meaningful certification.

areas.promise: Turns, phases, steps, priority passing, and empty-window skipping behave correctly in 1v1 and multiplayer.
areas.next: Add multiplayer APNAP priority fixtures and browser proof for skip rest of turn after stack/combat windows.

areas.promise: State-based actions run at the right times for lethal damage, zero toughness, legend rule, commander damage, empty library, and player loss.
areas.next: Add simultaneous win/loss ordering tests and expand SBA coverage for layer/removal dependencies.

areas.promise: High-power 1v1 and 4-player games are repeatedly stress-tested through legal public actions for crashes and illegal state drift.
areas.next: Run long-mode chaos regularly and promote every found failure into a targeted regression.

areas.promise: Spell casting validates timing, costs, commander tax, alternative/additional costs, X, cost reducers, and restricted mana.
areas.next: Expand alternative costs, additional costs, cost increasers/reducers, X choices, and free-spell casting prompts.

areas.promise: Lands, rocks, creature mana, restricted mana, treasure-like mana, and summoning sickness restrictions work.
areas.next: Add complete coverage for conditional lands, color choice UI, delayed/restricted mana, and mana replacement/multipliers.

areas.promise: Attacks, blocks, combat damage, commander damage, evasion, trample, first/double strike, lifelink, deathtouch, and multiplayer defenders work.
areas.next: Expand multiplayer combat matrix with more mixed evasion, planeswalker/battle defenders, and UI combat certification.

areas.promise: Spells, activated abilities, triggered abilities, counterspells, target inspection, priority, and stack resolution are correct.
areas.next: Certify responding to stack items in UI and broaden APNAP fixtures with replacement/choice prompts.

areas.promise: Legal targets, target changes, target loss, any target, nonland permanent, spells on stack, players, and multiplayer targeting work.
areas.next: Add target revalidation on resolution, illegal target fizzles, target-changing effects, and multiplayer target selection UI.

areas.promise: Creature, artifact, treasure, clue, food, blood, map, copy, and named tokens have correct types, colors, P/T, abilities, and ownership.
areas.next: Add a token factory certification table and browser proof for Krenko, Talrand, Goblin Spymaster, Dockside-style counting, and token sacrifice.

areas.promise: ETB, death, attack, damage, cast, draw, upkeep, beginning combat, end step, and delayed triggers fire once and at correct times.
areas.next: Create a trigger matrix by event kind and add missing beginning/end step token triggers.

areas.promise: Instead, prevention, enters-as, enters-tapped, replacement draws, commander zone replacement, and can't-lose effects apply without using the stack.
areas.next: Add affected-player ordering choices when multiple replacements apply and expand cannot-lose/win replacement fixtures.

areas.promise: Type-changing, P/T changes, ability grants/removes, control effects, devotion, timestamps, dependency, and layers are correct.
areas.next: Expand layer engine to full CR-style dependency/timestamp model beyond current practical layer 6/7 and devotion coverage.

areas.promise: Evergreen combat and static keywords work in rules and UI.
areas.next: Audit every evergreen keyword and bind each to at least one fixture card.

areas.promise: Set mechanics such as mutate, adventure, foretell, disturb, day/night, dungeons, initiative, monarch, energy, poison, and similar mechanics work or are explicitly unsupported.
areas.next: Keep promoting unsupported mechanics from the tracker into engine-native implementation, starting with Adventure, Mutate, Foretell, Cascade/Discover, and dungeon progress.

areas.promise: Choose one/more, optional effects, may-pay prompts, named-card choices, choose color/type/player, and dice/coin/random choices are represented.
areas.next: Continue replacing deterministic shortcuts with the existing typed prompt lifecycle until modal, optional, naming, color/type, and random-choice flows all round-trip through request validation.

areas.promise: Search, reveal, shuffle, top/bottom placement, exile-from-library, ordering, and tutor choices are interactive and rules-correct.
areas.next: Replace deterministic tutor shortcuts with choice UI that supports named card, top-library, graveyard, exile, and battlefield destinations.

areas.promise: Graveyard/exile actions, inspectability, flashback/escape/disturb/reanimate, and replacement zone moves work.
areas.next: Add zone permission engine for casting/activating from non-hand zones.

areas.promise: Equip, Auras, reattach, unattached state, illegal attachment cleanup, and granted stats/keywords work.
areas.next: Add UI certification for equip and illegal attachment SBAs.

areas.promise: Command zone, tax, commander damage, color identity, partners, backgrounds, doctor companion, and cast restrictions work.
areas.next: Add partner/background/doctor companion import and cast certification plus Drannith-style restrictions.

areas.promise: 1v1v1v1 games handle turn order, priority, attackers, life totals, eliminated players, and shared room state.
areas.next: Keep running long four-player chaos and hosted room UI proof while adding more high-power pod archetypes.

areas.promise: Pasted lists, Moxfield, Archidekt, TappedOut, MTGGoldfish, partners, DFCs, duplicates, basics, snow basics, and malformed lists are safe.
areas.next: Add importer golden corpus for real exported lists and bad-data cases.

areas.promise: Oracle text parser maps common card text into typed effects without card-specific hardcoding.
areas.next: Use the generated syntax clusters to pick the next parser/executor fixtures and rerun npm run coverage:parser after every card-data refresh.

areas.promise: Complex cards that cannot be safely parsed generically use audited overrides with tests.
areas.next: Fill specific owner/reason metadata for every legacy override and link each override to a regression fixture or parser-coverage cluster.

areas.promise: Every public action has a reachable, understandable, inspectable UI path on desktop and mobile.
areas.next: Add browser automation certification for each starter deck and all action categories.

areas.promise: Players can make controlled repair adjustments for visible battlefield state when an alpha/beta engine miss happens.
areas.next: Add replay-audited correction summaries and deeper correction review UX on top of the existing counter, token, zone, attachment, damage, mana, commander damage, and phase repair actions.

areas.promise: Post-game play-by-play and grading reflect legal choices, board state, and missed alternatives.
areas.next: Broaden authoritative review records into full line comparison, replay stepping, and rules-confidence versus strategy-confidence presentation.

areas.promise: AI plays legal, timely actions quickly, avoids premature phase skips, and evaluates interaction reasonably.
areas.next: Add politics/threat benchmarks across more board archetypes and stack-heavy high-power states.

areas.promise: Rules/card data updates are versioned, re-audited, and do not silently regress certified mechanics.
areas.next: Wire edge-case generation and coverage audit into a scheduled certification run after every card-data refresh.
